fate: Bass (1967), Chapter 3, Proposition 2.13, p. 75, proves precisely that End_A(M) is separable for finite projective M, with center A/ann(M). Its displayed matrix-unit element is independently checked here for all ranks by the index argument in proof_checks.md and for ranks 1–4 by exact computation. Faithfulness is needed only to identify the center with A.

statement: If L is a locally separable A-algebra and M is locally projective of finite type as an L-module, then M is locally projective of finite type as an A-module.

fate: Locally M is a direct summand of a finite power of L. The Azumaya hypotheses make L finite projective over A, and direct summands of finite projective modules remain finite projective. This is projectivity transitivity under the exact hypotheses used on the page.
